storyboards.title: Frontal Record
storyboards.summary: A flat, well-lit frontal portrait whose job is to record the new haircut against the existing face. The explicit hair constraint outranks Stable DNA hair and suppresses it for this run; every other identity field still applies and characters/ch-harim/character.json is untouched.

shots.purpose: Record the new hair length unambiguously against a neutral backdrop.
shots.description: Waist-up frontal portrait of Harim against a plain grey backdrop, short blunt bob ending just below the jaw, even soft key, shoulders square to camera.

continuity.hair_state: override: short blunt bob just below the jaw

sample_request.raw_user_prompt: Harim in the studio, new short haircut, plain grey backdrop, waist-up portrait.

scene_spec.hair: short blunt bob just below the jaw; no hair below the shoulders
scene_spec.lighting: even soft key with a gentle fill, no dramatic shadow

immutable_constraints.hair: short blunt bob just below the jaw; no hair below the shoulders

storyboards.title: Three-Quarter Turn
storyboards.summary: The same override read at an angle, where a bob is easiest to verify against the jawline. Same suppression, different framing.

shots.purpose: Verify the cut against the jawline where length is hardest to fake.
shots.description: Waist-up three-quarter portrait of Harim against a plain grey backdrop, short blunt bob ending just below the jaw, head turned twenty degrees, soft directional key from screen left.

continuity.hair_state: override: short blunt bob just below the jaw
